title: Grilled Filipino Corn with White Corn and Dried Kissed Fillet
description: A delicious fusion of Filipino flavors with a sweet twist on grilled corn, paired with tender and flavorful dried kissed fillet.
instructions: Soak the dried kissed fillet in water for 4 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium heat.
Brush the grates with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the corn for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2 minutes until slightly charred.
Season the grilled corn with Filipino seasoning.
Grill the dried kissed fillet for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve the grilled corn with the grilled dried kissed fillet.
Optional: Add a drizzle of oil for extra flavor.
